attributes.name: carousel pagination indicator shape
attributes.definition: The visual form of the pagination controls used to navigate a carousel.

values.definition: Small round dot indicators without numbers.
Other indicator style or no pagination.

attributes.name: carousel pagination placement and active state
attributes.definition: Where the carousel pagination sits relative to the slide and how the active item is marked.

values.value: overlapping bottom edge with accent-filled active
values.definition: Indicators overlap the bottom of the hero image and the active one is filled with the accent color.
Indicators sit outside the image area.
Placement or active styling is not asserted.

attributes.name: control corner radius
attributes.definition: Corner rounding applied to buttons and small controls.

values.definition: Controls use pill-shaped or circular radii.

codes.attribute: carousel pagination placement and active state
codes.value: overlapping bottom edge with accent-filled active
